modules.module_title: Interpret information from project design docket and drawings

pcs.pc_description: analyze the layouts and key elements of the engineering drawings
interpret Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) symbols in the drawings
identify the sequence of operations required for project execution based on drawing details
explain need for any modifications/changes required in the drawing
ensure proper storage and management of the drawings in an easily accessible place

modules.module_title: Supervise and review the on-site work of various teams

pcs.pc_description: plan the optimized processes at the various bays of the workshop to ensure smooth operations
select the correct materials as per the drawings and specifications
ensure that the placement of materials, tools, and equipment on the designated bays for effective work execution
ensure that the equipment and tools in maintained appropriately
ensure availability of the appropriate personal protective equipment to all people working on the bays of the workshop
ensure that the appropriate floor and machine guards are in place
ensure regular cleaning and maintenance of worksite during project execution
identify and prevent hazards and control risks at work site according to company requirements

modules.module_title: Perform the required fabrication, assembly, finishing and installation operations directly and/or via teams

pcs.pc_description: prepare the job cards in accordance with the production process flow
select and safely use hand and power tools to cut joints safely and accurately
perform required woodworking operation based on product specifications
prepare accurate joints and intersections with no gaps and attach the members neatly using appropriate fasteners
accurately assemble and erect structures without damage to components, personal risk, the risk to others, or property
perform finishing to a specification, with attention to surface finishes and avoidance of damage or unsightly marking of components

modules.module_title: Perform the installation operations directly and/or via teams

pcs.pc_description: perform the installation and fitting of required hardware and accessories on the product
install the product based on design specifications and layout details

modules.module_title: Schedule and conduct periodic quality checks of products/projects

pcs.pc_description: plan and organize quality checks in accordance with project execution timelines
ensure appropriate action gets taken for fault rectification in consultation with the supervisor
check for structural strength and load- bearing capacity by applying load on the finished furniture
ensure that all the product dimensions and finishes comply with the desired details
ensure compliance to all the requisite documents post completion of the project

pcs.pc_description: comply with health and personal hygiene- related protocols
maintain adequate inventory of cleaning materials and consumables
identify and report poor organizational practices concerning hygiene, food handling, cleaning
ensure that the trash cans or waste collection points are cleared every day
maintain records for cleanliness and maintenance schedule

monitor the usage of harmful chemicals inside the work area as per the specified guidelines only

employ an effective process to dispose off the hazardous material and wastage
employ safe working practices to perform a lift, carry or move heavy wooden furniture and accessories from one place to another
